faqs.a:
Any person who fishes for game fish in waters at the reservoir must possess a valid
               state fishing license. All state laws, rules, or regulations relating to fishing apply
               at the reservoir. The City of Arvada reserves the right to check fish bag limits.
               Any person who has been warned and continues to catch more fish than allowed may be
               summarily removed from the reservoir by a police officer, designated parks employee,
               or park ranger. After notice and hearing, the permit of any person so removed may
               be revoked by the city.
(Code 1981, § 22-25; Ord. No. 2577, § 2, 12-19-1988;
Ord. No. 4256, § 2, 3-21-2011
)
